en_title: Parties, Murals, and Anxiety — What It's Like to Launch a GTA Game
cn_title: 派对、壁画与焦虑——推出一款GTA游戏是什么体验
opus_summary: Rockstar前员工回忆《GTA5》等游戏的发行经历：有人参加盛大派对，有人在酒吧看到自己的动画作品，也有人感受到发售前的焦虑。团队曾为《GTA5》过场动画的灯光问题赶工，并在后期获悉要加入第一人称模式。

paragraphs.en: GTA 6 is finally coming on November 19 and is already breaking records. It’s the most anticipated video game launch of all time and on track to be the most successful entertainment product ever released. The pressure must be unimaginable for the people working at developer and publisher Rockstar as the entire world’s gaze looks them squarely in the eyes.
paragraphs.cn: 《GTA6》终于将于11月19日推出，而且已经开始打破纪录。这是有史以来最受期待的一次电子游戏发行，并有望成为有史以来最成功的娱乐产品。全世界的目光都直直地投向开发商兼发行商Rockstar，其员工所承受的压力一定难以想象。

paragraphs.en: So, what’s it like to launch one of the biggest pieces of entertainment of all time? Is it scary? Is it fun? How anxious does it make you? Well, it largely depends on where you’re based.
paragraphs.cn: 那么，推出有史以来规模最大的娱乐作品之一是什么体验？会害怕吗？会觉得有趣吗？这会让你有多焦虑？这在很大程度上取决于你在哪里工作。

paragraphs.en: For former Rockstar researcher Gregory Johnson, who lived in New York and travelled all over the world to document criminals and culture for Dan Houser and the rest of GTA 5’s writing team for 16 years, it meant attending a private mashup concert for Rockstar’s devs, friends and family at the Lincoln Center, headlined by German electronic music band Tangerine Dream and hip hop producers Alchemist and Oh No. “It was just grand in scale,” Johnson told me during a recent IGN interview.
paragraphs.cn: 对Rockstar前研究员Gregory Johnson来说，这意味着在Lincoln Center参加一场为Rockstar开发人员及其亲友举办的私人混搭音乐会，由德国电子音乐乐队Tangerine Dream以及嘻哈制作人Alchemist和Oh No领衔演出。Johnson住在纽约，16年来一直走遍世界各地，为Dan Houser和《GTA5》编剧团队的其他成员记录犯罪分子和文化。「那场面规模宏大。」Johnson最近在接受我为IGN进行的采访时说。

paragraphs.en: For designer Matt Freedman, who worked out of Toronto, Canada, it was a different experience. “There was certainly a party culture around Rockstar, but the wrap parties were generally the tamer kind of thing,” he said. “They were nice. They were very fancy, but it kind of became a formula after a while — the young guys love it because you're going to a fancy restaurant and you get all the food you can eat and all you can drink.”
paragraphs.cn: 对在加拿大多伦多工作的设计师Matt Freedman来说，体验则有所不同。「Rockstar当然有派对文化，但完工派对通常比较温和，」他说，「派对很不错。非常高档，但过了一段时间就有点模式化了——年轻人很喜欢，因为你可以去高档餐厅，想吃多少就吃多少，想喝多少就喝多少。」

paragraphs.en: Mike York, who worked at Rockstar New England as an animator for five years, barely saw anything at all. There was a big party for the developers when GTA 5 launched, but his biggest memory of that time though came from being in a local bar with his friends.
paragraphs.cn: 曾在Rockstar New England担任五年动画师的Mike York几乎什么都没见到。《GTA5》推出时，开发人员举办了一场盛大的派对，但他对那段时间最深刻的记忆，却是在当地一家酒吧和朋友们待在一起。

paragraphs.en: “The trailer came up, and it showed some of my animation,” York said. “It was Trevor stomping on the toilet — something like that. I was like, ‘Oh my god! Look, look, look, look, look, look, look! That's the game I'm working on. That's my s**t right there. That's my animation, dude.’ We're like freaking out at the bar, you know. That was the only time I saw GTA 5 where I was living. We were in a small town in New England. It's called Andover, Massachusetts. It's a small place, and there's no big murals going up there.”
paragraphs.cn: 「预告片放了出来，里面展示了一些我制作的动画，」York说，「是Trevor踩踏马桶的画面——大概是那样。我当时就说：‘我的天啊！看，看，看，看，看，看，看！那是我正在做的游戏。那他妈是我的作品。那是我做的动画，伙计。’我们在酒吧里都快激动疯了，你知道的。那是我在居住的地方唯一一次看到《GTA5》。我们当时在新英格兰的一个小镇上，叫马萨诸塞州Andover。那是个小地方，那里不会出现大型壁画。」

paragraphs.en: Of course, there’s going to be some disparity. New York is the beating heart of Rockstar Games, its head office, despite the company originating from Scotland. When he wasn’t on a ride along with police through Mexican gang territory for GTA research , Gregory Johnson was in a passenger seat on the bridge of the Rockstar mothership. He saw the evolution of Rockstar’s launch process from the command center itself, and watched that process evolve from the release of San Andreas through to Red Dead Redemption 2.
paragraphs.cn: 当然，其中难免有些差异。尽管Rockstar起源于苏格兰，纽约才是公司的核心和总部所在地。Gregory Johnson不为《侠盗猎车手》研究而随警察乘车穿过墨西哥帮派的地盘时，就坐在Rockstar母舰指挥桥的副驾驶座上。他在指挥中心亲眼见证了Rockstar发行流程的演变，看着这一流程从《侠盗猎车手：圣安地列斯》发售一直发展到《荒野大镖客：救赎2》。

paragraphs.en: “Starting with GTA San Andreas, there was this playbook where they would do these huge murals around the city and around other cities,” Johnson said. “They're doing that right now with GTA 6. Well, they have mastered it at this point. This is like the final form of everything I saw. But when they started with GTA San Andreas, they would do a lot of huge murals. They would have these amazing midnight launch events, where they would bring in game journalists and various influencers for first looks at the gameplay.
paragraphs.cn: 「从《侠盗猎车手：圣安地列斯》开始，他们就有了这样一套宣传方案：在这座城市和其他城市各处制作巨幅壁画，」Johnson说，「他们现在也正在为《GTA6》这么做。嗯，到了这个阶段，他们已经驾轻就熟了。这就像我所见过的一切的最终形态。但他们从《侠盗猎车手：圣安地列斯》开始时，会制作很多巨幅壁画。他们还会举办精彩的午夜发售活动，邀请游戏记者和各类网红来抢先体验游戏玩法。

paragraphs.en: “That playbook, as I understand it, started with GTA San Andreas. Although that was, frankly, the first Rockstar game I worked on. GTA 4 was set in New York City, so it was an opportunity for us to build out a GTA that was right in our backyard — unlike GTA 3, which had East Coast vibes, they got more and more true to the city that inspired the game.”
paragraphs.cn: 「据我了解，那套方案始于《侠盗猎车手：圣安地列斯》。不过坦白说，那是我参与制作的第一款Rockstar游戏。《侠盗猎车手4》的背景设定在纽约市，所以我们有机会打造一款就发生在我们家门口的《侠盗猎车手》——不同于带有东海岸风格的《侠盗猎车手3》，他们越来越忠实地呈现出为游戏提供灵感的那座城市。」

paragraphs.en: Instead of jumping on a plane to go on research trips, suddenly Johnson was hopping on a train out to Greenpoint, Brooklyn, Harlem, or Queens to spend time among the various enclaves of America’s most diverse melting pot. As launch closed in, he started to see “wanted” posters for GTA 4 protagonist Niko Bellic popping up around the different boroughs, his work life bleeding into his surroundings.
paragraphs.cn: Johnson突然不用再搭飞机出差做研究，而是乘火车前往布鲁克林的Greenpoint、Harlem或Queens，在美国最多元化的大熔炉中的各个聚居区度过时间。随着发售日临近，他开始看到《侠盗猎车手4》主角Niko Bellic的「通缉」海报出现在各个城区，他的工作生活渗入了周围的环境。

paragraphs.en: “There was a lot of stuff that basically borrowed from what hip hop street teams would do,” Johnson explained. “So that's what the wanted posters were and the Rockstar stickers all over the city, and doing the grand murals. We had people like DJ Premier run an exclusive event around the time of launch at APT, a club that was near and dear to my heart at that time. People came up to SiriusXM Satellite Radio where another hip hop DJ, Green Lantern, had his show, and I think Premiere came through for that as well. They had live gameplay, and people calling in — just building up the drama all over New York, and really getting the city behind it.”
paragraphs.cn: 「很多做法基本上借鉴了嘻哈街头宣传团队的手段，」Johnson解释道，「通缉海报、遍布全城的Rockstar贴纸以及制作巨幅壁画都是如此。发售前后，我们请DJ Premier等人在APT举办了一场专场活动，那是我当时非常喜欢的一家俱乐部。人们来到SiriusXM Satellite Radio，另一位嘻哈DJ Green Lantern在那里主持节目，我想Premiere也来参加了。他们现场展示游戏玩法，人们还打电话参与——这就是在纽约各处营造声势，真正让整座城市支持这款游戏。」

paragraphs.en: Rockstar has gone even more all-out for GTA 6, with massive Vice City-themed blimps, modded cars to look like the in-game models driving around Miami, taking over the Kaseya Center and putting the local NBA team in a Vice City kit to celebrate GTA 6’s upcoming launch. But even before all of that, the city of Miami was ready for Rockstar’s return — despite the last GTA game set in Vice City launching more than 20 years ago.
paragraphs.cn: Rockstar为《GTA6》更加不遗余力：巨大的罪恶都市主题飞艇、改装成游戏内车型并在迈阿密巡游的汽车、接管Kaseya Center，以及让当地NBA球队穿上罪恶都市主题球衣，都是为了庆祝《GTA6》即将推出。但在这一切发生之前，迈阿密市就已经为Rockstar的回归做好了准备——尽管上一款以罪恶都市为背景的《侠盗猎车手》游戏是在20多年前推出的。

paragraphs.en: “I remember when we were doing research trips [for GTA 6] around South Florida, in Miami in particular, even at that time in 2016 there were murals paying homage to Vice City, people calling their businesses Vice City,” Johnson explained. “For [Rockstar] it was still a little bit stunning, the degree to which Miami embraced this alternate identity of itself is Vice City. The fact that they embraced it as a part of the city's identity really gave Rockstar the green light.”
paragraphs.cn: 「我记得我们当时在南佛罗里达各地，尤其是迈阿密，进行［《GTA6》的］实地考察，即便是在2016年那时，就已经有了致敬罪恶都市的壁画，人们还用罪恶都市为自己的商铺命名，」Johnson解释道，「迈阿密接纳自己作为罪恶都市这一另类身份的程度，对［Rockstar］来说仍有点令人震惊。他们将其接纳为城市身份的一部分，这件事确实给Rockstar开了绿灯。」

paragraphs.en: Before all the celebrations, the murals, the city coming out to celebrate the game, though, there was the fear. According to Matt Freedman, there was anxiety in the air at Rockstar as it prepared to launch GTA 5.
paragraphs.cn: 不过，在所有庆祝活动、壁画和整座城市出来庆祝这款游戏之前，先出现的是恐惧。据Matt Freedman说，在Rockstar准备推出《GTA5》时，公司里弥漫着焦虑的气氛。

paragraphs.en: Unlike movies, where you can see through the viewfinder and get an idea of how your film looks, video games are in utero until right at the end of the project. “GTA 5 came together about two months before launch,” he said. Things get changed and cut, previously separate parts are stitched together, and only right at the end do these disparate parts meld and you find out whether you’ve made something worthwhile. Considering the long development times of these sprawling, ambitious open world games with complex NPC behaviors, simulated physics and epic stories, it’s no wonder there’s some trepidation.
paragraphs.cn: 电影可以通过取景器看到画面，大致了解成片的模样；电子游戏则不同，直到项目最后阶段都还在孕育之中。「《GTA5》是在发售前大约两个月才成型的。」他说。内容会被修改和删减，原本分离的部分会被拼接起来，只有到了最后，这些不同的部分才会融合，你才能知道自己做出的东西是否有价值。考虑到这些规模庞大、雄心勃勃的开放世界游戏具有复杂的NPC行为、模拟物理效果和史诗般的故事，开发时间又很长，难怪会有人感到不安。

paragraphs.en: “Launching a Rockstar game, it's very much running a marathon for like six years,” Freedman explained. “You're going at a very deliberate, very steady pace. You're just rocking those 60 to 80-hour work weeks, and you're in that groove. They're very large, very complex projects. Rockstar's got its process figured out quite well. But in all the Rockstar games I'd worked on, we're all in a bit of a panic up until launch. Probably the best example was Grand Theft Auto Online. No one thought that thing was gonna work, man. Everyone was like, ‘Thank God we got single-player because our online certainly is lame.’ We had two hours of content, a very small amount of content at the start.
paragraphs.cn: 「推出一款Rockstar游戏，很像是跑了大约六年的马拉松，」Freedman解释道，「你以非常审慎、非常稳定的步调前进。你每周工作60到80小时，进入那种节奏。这些项目规模非常大，也非常复杂。Rockstar已经很好地摸索出了一套流程。但在我参与过的所有Rockstar游戏中，我们直到发售前都有点恐慌。最好的例子大概就是《GTA Online》。伙计，没人觉得那东西能成功。大家都说：‘谢天谢地我们还有单人模式，因为我们的线上模式肯定很差劲。’我们一开始只有两个小时的内容，内容量非常少。

paragraphs.en: “Rockstar to their credit just kept working on it. It got a little bit of heat, got a little bit of excitement, and then they kept building on it. You never really know exactly what's going to work and what's not going to work. You can be super conservative and give people what they wanted yesterday, and it's not what they want today, and I think to Rockstar's credit, they're very willing to try new ideas and try new things."
paragraphs.cn: 「值得称赞的是，Rockstar一直在继续开发它。它获得了一点关注，激起了一些热情，然后他们继续在此基础上完善。你永远无法确切知道什么会成功，什么不会。你可以非常保守，给人们他们昨天想要的东西，但那可能不是他们今天想要的。我认为Rockstar值得称赞的一点是，他们非常愿意尝试新想法和新事物。」

paragraphs.en: Around five months before GTA 5’s launch, another problem appeared. The developers realized they’d budgeted real-time lighting for cutscenes incorrectly, which would have caused major performance issues on PS3 and Xbox 360. Every single cutscene (double digit hours of scenes) had the problem, lit with one environment light and five point lights — the latter had to be reduced down to two. The cutscene team had to relight every single cutscene in the game before the launch deadline.
paragraphs.cn: 在《GTA5》发售前大约五个月，又出现了一个问题。开发人员意识到，他们错误估算了过场动画的实时光照预算，这会在PS3和XBOX 360上造成严重的性能问题。每一段过场动画（总时长达两位数小时）都有这个问题：它们使用一盏环境光和五盏点光源照明，而后者必须减少到两盏。过场动画团队不得不在发售期限之前重新为游戏中的每一段过场动画布光。

paragraphs.en: “To the cutscene team's credit, and to the lighting artist's credit, they got it done, and those cutscenes look fantastic,” Freedman said. “Man, I would have loved to have seen it with them with the original lighting setup. I don't know if they ever got a chance to put that back in there [with the next-gen version]. I don't think they did, but the old ones must have looked spectacular, considering how good the current ones look.”
paragraphs.cn: 「过场动画团队和灯光美术师值得称赞，他们完成了工作，那些过场动画看起来棒极了，」Freedman说，「伙计，我真想看看采用原始灯光设置的版本是什么样。我不知道他们后来有没有机会把它加回去［用在次世代版本中］。我认为他们没有，但考虑到现在的效果有多好，原来的版本一定非常壮观。」

paragraphs.en: On the animation side, things had slowed right down. According to former animator Mike York, animators and artists become “glorified QA” for the final stretch because the game goes on lockdown and no new elements are allowed to be added. Instead, they work through the game looking for bugs, helping the QA department polish things up for release. Until one day, when a message came down from the top of the company: we’re adding first-person.
paragraphs.cn: 动画方面的工作已经大幅放缓。据前动画师Mike York说，在最后冲刺阶段，动画师和美术师成了「说得好听的QA」，因为游戏进入了锁定状态，不允许加入任何新元素。他们转而通玩游戏寻找漏洞，帮助QA部门为发售打磨游戏。直到有一天，公司高层传来一条消息：我们要加入第一人称视角。

paragraphs.en: “They were like, ‘We’re adding first-person mode,’” York explained. “We’re like, ‘What?’ You don’t do that — you don’t just come in and add first-person mode. There's thousands of animations that need to be created, and thousands of animations that need to be adjusted or redone in a different way and re-exported and and put in so that you could use that one instead of the other one, and it caused a ton of work for everyone.”
paragraphs.cn: 「他们说：‘我们要加入第一人称模式。’」York解释道，「我们就说：‘什么？’你不能这么做——不能就这么跑过来加入第一人称模式。有数千个动画需要制作，还有数千个动画需要调整，或者以不同方式重做、重新导出并放进游戏，这样你才能用新的替换原来的。这给每个人都带来了大量工作。」

paragraphs.en: Eventually, GTA 5 would ship without first-person support because of the time it took to implement. It only came as a feature when the next-gen version dropped on PS4 and Xbox One.
paragraphs.cn: 最终，由于实现这一功能需要时间，《GTA5》发售时并不支持第一人称视角。直到次世代版本登陆PS4和XBOX One时，这项功能才加入游戏。

paragraphs.en: “It's like pushing anything new out into the world,” Johnson added. “The closer you get to that moment, it's a natural human thing to feel a lot of anxiety and breathless anticipation. But I think there is, especially after all of these years, a certain degree of faith in the process. This company has wildly succeeded in the past.
paragraphs.cn: 「这就像把任何新事物推向世界一样，」Johnson补充道，「越接近那个时刻，感到十分焦虑以及令人屏息的期待，是人之常情。但我认为，尤其是在经历了这么多年之后，我们对这个流程有一定程度的信心。这家公司过去取得过巨大的成功。

paragraphs.en: “One of the things that Dan Houser always told us as a research team was that we've got to get buy-in inside the building as much as possible in order to get buy-in outside of the building. So we’ve got to be true believers in our own product. So a lot of the work we did was just you know raising the cultural IQ across the company as much as possible. Like with anything else, if you feel like you've done all this preparation and all this hard work, and you've got a great plan, and you've got a great track record, and a very capable marketing team, I think you've got to trust your work.”
paragraphs.cn: 「Dan Houser经常对我们研究团队说的一件事是，要想获得大楼外的认可，就必须尽可能多地获得大楼内的认可。所以我们必须真心相信自己的产品。因此，我们做的很多工作，就是尽可能提高整个公司的文化素养。和其他任何事情一样，如果你觉得自己已经做了所有这些准备和艰苦的工作，有了出色的计划、出色的过往成绩以及一支非常能干的营销团队，我认为你就必须相信自己的工作。」

paragraphs.en: Millions have been spent on getting the word out there for a game that’s reportedly already earned $1 billion in preorders alone and become the most preordered game in the history of PlayStation and Xbox. For context, Spider-Man: Brand New Day is the highest grossing opening for a movie of all time, and it didn’t even make half that much in its opening weekend. GTA 6 is a behemoth unlike anything we’ve seen.
paragraphs.cn: 为了宣传这款游戏，已经花费了数百万；据报道，它仅靠预购就已获得10亿美元收入，并成为PlayStation和XBOX史上预购量最高的游戏。作为对比，《蜘蛛侠：崭新之日》是有史以来首映票房最高的电影，而它的首映周末票房甚至不到这个数字的一半。《GTA6》是一个我们从未见过的庞然大物。

paragraphs.en: That’s reflected in the marketing, which knows it already has the gamers and is attempting to seduce the rest of the world with flashy, over-the-top activations. NBA team the Miami Heat will wear Vice City-themed jerseys for a match around the game’s launch. The top of the Kaseya Center , home of The Heat, was lit up to usher in the collaboration between Rockstar and Miami’s home team. Real life cars are being modded to look like their GTA 6 counterparts and driven around Miami before being auctioned off for $1.3 million. If there’s anxiety at the studio over GTA 6, Rockstar isn’t showing it.
paragraphs.cn: 这一点体现在营销上：营销团队知道自己已经赢得了玩家，正试图以炫目、夸张的推广活动吸引世界上的其他人。NBA球队迈阿密热火将在游戏发售前后的一场比赛中穿上罪恶都市主题球衣。热火主场Kaseya Center的顶部亮起灯光，迎接Rockstar与迈阿密主队的合作。现实中的汽车正被改装成《GTA6》中相应车型的模样，并在迈阿密巡游，之后将以130万美元拍卖。如果工作室对《GTA6》感到焦虑，Rockstar并没有表现出来。
